howTo.priceTitle: Price against the close, not results
howTo.price: A test is judged by how much better your price was than the closing price without the book's margin ({term}), not by how many picks won. A pick's result swings wildly; price against the close swings little, so 50 rows with a close say more than hundreds of results.
howTo.se: The {term} measures how far the mean could move by luck alone; a mean 2 standard errors or more above zero is hard to put down to luck.
howTo.onceTitle: Why a test is decided once
howTo.once: If you look at a test every week and decide when it looks good, sooner or later one passes by pure luck. So each test is decided once, when it reaches its count, by a rule fixed before the data was seen. Yield and hit rate are shown as context: they decide nothing.
howTo.bars: Each test has two bars: graded rows and rows with a two-sided close. It needs both. The strip shows the mean with its ±2 standard error interval against the zero line.

review.rule: A Shadow review is due only when both hold: at least {days} days since the last "Revisión Sombra" row in Decisions, and at least {rows} rows graded since it.

frozen.intro: Model tests that keep being logged exactly as they are. Rule of row 111: each is decided once, at {graded} rows, by price against the close and not by results; if it passes you are offered real money at {stake}u, never applied on its own.
frozen.measure: EV of the price against the close
frozen.noMeasure: No rows with a two-sided close yet.
frozen.ruleCollecting: Nothing is decided until {graded} graded rows with {close} closes, whatever the results look like.
frozen.ruleCollectingCloses: It already has {graded} graded rows; it waits until {close} have a two-sided close.
frozen.rulePass: With z {z} (2 or more), the review would offer you real money at {stake}u on this test. It is never applied on its own: you decide.
frozen.ruleStop: With z {z} (under 2), the review would propose stopping the category.

frozen.projectionReached: It has reached its decision count.
frozen.projectionNone: No graded rows in the last {days} days: no pace to estimate from.

frozen.explorer: See the rows in the Explorer

what.rule30_pass_all: Match-total corners and cards that passed every filter and are held back only by the rule 30 pause.
what.cards_under: The model's match-total card unders, priced 1.70–4.0, both teams 10+ games, whether or not they pass the filters.
what.under45_control: The Under 4.5 line inside the card-under test, with its own decision.
what.corner_rejects: Match-total corners the model likes but a filter rejected (F-gap, F-ratio or razor), priced 1.70–2.0.
what.team_corners: One team's corners that passed every filter (rule 32).
what.model_only_shots: The daily team-shots pick with the model's highest probability, even when the book disagrees; priced 1.70–4.0.
what.match_total_shots: Match-total shots and shots on target with the verdict SHADOW (rule 25).
what.relaxed_sample_corners: Match-total corners with the relaxed 6–9 game sample (rule 18).

priceFirst.title: Price-first tests
priceFirst.intro: Picks judged against a consensus fair price across books, with no model. Each has its own rule, not row 111's.

what.value: Results and goals where a book pays 3% or more over the consensus fair price (rule 29).
what.near_value: Results and goals where a book pays 0% to 3% over the fair price: they judge the 3% threshold.
what.prop_value: Match-total corners and cards where a book, priced 1.70–4.0, pays 3% or more over the consensus of books with both sides.
what.prop_near_value: Match-total corners and cards 0% to 3% over the consensus, up to 3 per slate.

rule.value: Decided before the data (rows 79 and 80): the deciding line is price 4.0 or less. It passes with 30+ graded rows with fair-close EV, a mean above zero and positive flat yield. If it passes, real money is proposed on ≤4.0, or only on ≤3.0 if the 3.0–4.0 band has 10+ rows with a negative mean. If ≤4.0 fails but ≤3.0 passes, ≤3.0 is judged only on rows from 30 Oct. If neither passes, results and goals stay SHADOW. Always at a small stake and with your approval.
rule.near_value: No decision of its own: reported apart from VALOR to see whether the 3% threshold is right.
rule.prop_value: Fixed on 6 Nov before any rows (row 97): at {first} graded rows with a two-sided bet365 close, if it is CLEAR (the whole 95% interval above zero and positive flat yield) you are offered real money at {stake}u; if the mean is zero or less, stopping is proposed; otherwise it goes on to {final}, where CLEAR is proposed and anything else stops.
rule.prop_near_value: No decision of its own: reported apart from VALOR PROP.

case.a: The ≤4.0 line clears the gate: real money on ≤4.0 would be proposed.
case.a_le3: The ≤4.0 line clears it, but the 3.0–4.0 band is negative on 10+ rows: only ≤3.0 would be proposed.
case.b: ≤4.0 fails but ≤3.0 passes, also on the rows since 30 Oct: ≤3.0 would be proposed.
case.b_waiting: ≤4.0 fails and ≤3.0 passes, but ≤3.0 must pass on rows since 30 Oct alone: not yet.
case.c: Neither ≤4.0 nor ≤3.0 passes: results and goals stay SHADOW.

propState.collecting: Not yet at {target} rows with a two-sided bet365 close: nothing is decided.
propState.pass: CLEAR: the whole 95% interval above zero and positive yield. Real money at {stake}u would be proposed.
propState.stop: Stopping the category would be proposed.
propState.extended: Neither clear nor negative at {first}: it goes on to {final} rows.

priceFirst.valueCollecting: Not yet {total} rows with fair-close EV on the ≤4.0 line: nothing is decided.

stopped.intro: No longer logged (or their rows never count), but still in the sheet. When and why they stopped, with their final numbers.

why.ai_watch_corners: Sofascore's AI on corners did not beat the close; it stopped being logged.
why.ai_watch_cards: Sofascore's AI on cards did not beat the close either; stopped at the 500-row review.
why.team_corner_rejects: Since 2 Nov only team corners that pass every filter are logged; the rejects did worse against the close.
why.team_shots: Team shots lost to the market; only match totals and the MODELO SOLO pick remain.
why.corner_card_fillers: Corner and card rejects used as fillers lost to the close whatever the rejection reason.
why.shots_fillers: Shots rejects stopped being fillers: only a shots pick with the verdict SHADOW is logged.
why.model_only_shots_low: MODELO SOLO rows under 1.70: they could never be a bet (rule 5), so they don't count toward the test.
